summary: Horseless Carriage is a heavy economic game from the designers behind Antiquity and Food Chain Magnate, casting players as early automobile manufacturers speculating on parts, demand, and factory tech trees. It's long, mechanically dense, and rewards careful reading of a fluctuating commodity market over multiple hours.
praised: deep, satisfying economic simulation of an emerging industry
strong sense of building up a manufacturing empire over time
criticised: very long playtime for a niche audience
market-based scoring can be opaque to new players
limited table availability/print run makes it hard to find

interaction.kind: commodity speculation and shared market pressure
interaction.detail: Players buy and sell into a shared, dynamic commodity market whose prices shift based on collective actions, so one player's speculation directly affects what others can profitably do, even though factory development itself sits on individual player boards.

sources: cash and asset value at game end
scoring.how_you_win: Money is the score throughout; after the fixed number of model years, whoever has amassed the most wealth from manufacturing and selling cars and speculating on commodities wins.
